granary.name: Granary
granary.note: What the jar keeps, the year forgets — and some of it is still there after the town grows.

temple.name: Temple
temple.note: Foreign faiths pressing on this city lose a quarter of their strength at its door.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.note: The town’s own joiners and masons. What they raise, they raise faster.

amphitheater.name: Amphitheater
amphitheater.note: Every second citizen of this city is worth a further song.

cathedral.name: Cathedral
cathedral.note: Dedicated to a patron the day it is finished. Units may be bought with faith in the city that holds it, at the rate gold buys them elsewhere.

reliquary.name: The Reliquary
reliquary.note: Units may be bought with faith in the city that holds it, at the same rate gold buys them elsewhere.

greatLighthouse.name: The Great Lighthouse
greatLighthouse.note: The extra trade route is empire-wide. The design calls for one per coastal city.

terracottaArmy.name: The Terracotta Army
terracottaArmy.note: Soldiers raised in this city are veterans from the day they muster, and stay veterans wherever they march.

statueOfZeus.name: The Statue of Zeus
statueOfZeus.note: Your soldiers strike harder at walls than at men.

alhambra.name: The Alhambra
deferred: units raised here begin dug in, as if they had already fortified
alhambra.note: Being dug in is something a piece does and stops doing, not something it is born with, so the second clause is not built.

waterClockOfSuSong.name: The Water Clock of Su Song
waterClockOfSuSong.note: The escapement keeps the realm's whole calendar. Every boon of yours that comes round on a beat comes round sooner, and on the clock's own beat the realm is paid in learning for everything its workshops made.

hallOfDeeds.name: Hall of Deeds
hallOfDeeds.note: No longer raised anywhere. The row is kept so that a game begun before the tree was re-cut still plays back exactly as it did.

steleOfLaws.name: Stele of Laws
steleOfLaws.note: The law, cut in stone where anyone may read it.

bazaar.name: Bazaar
bazaar.note: Every kind of luxury this city can reach pays a further gold here.

harbour.name: Harbour
harbour.note: Built on the coast. Every water hex the city works pays a further food.

baths.name: Baths
baths.note: Hot water, cold water, and somewhere to argue in between.

forum.name: Forum
forum.note: The square where the city hears itself think. One realm, one Forum.

examinationHall.name: Examination Hall
examinationHall.note: Clerks chosen by what they can write down.

courthouse.name: Courthouse
courthouse.note: Built only in a city taken by force. It answers for the whole cost of holding one.

shipyard.name: Shipyard
shipyard.note: Built on the coast. Ships leave the slips faster; everything else is built at the ordinary pace.

castle.name: Castle
castle.note: The town is worth more to storm, and takes longer to empty.

forge.name: Forge
forge.note: Soldiers are made here faster than anywhere else in the realm.

caravanserai.name: Caravanserai
caravanserai.note: A walled yard, a well, and room for one more trade route. Every caravan that sets out from this city carries more than it could alone.

printingHouse.name: Printing House
printingHouse.note: One carved character, used a thousand times.
deferred: Beakers and songs carried in by the caravans that end here wait until a route can pay its destination something the origin did not send.

observatory.name: Observatory
observatory.note: The sky, written down night after night. An observatory with a mountain inside the city’s borders reads it better.

lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
lighthouse.note: Built on the coast. Every water hex the city works feeds it a little better.

townCharter.name: Town Charter
townCharter.note: A city founded under Daughter Cities is founded holding one. It is never built and never bought.

clocktower.name: Clocktower
clocktower.note: The town keeps one hour, and everybody in it keeps the same one.

bank.name: Bank
bank.note: Coin that stays still long enough to be counted twice.
deferred: A further coin for each caravan route touching this city waits until a count can ask which routes end here.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.note: A wall with corners, so that nobody may stand anywhere it cannot be shot at. No technology opens it yet: the age that does has not been written.

alchemicalSociety.name: The Alchemical Society
alchemicalSociety.note: Every other workshop in the city sends its problems here, and gets an answer back.

chartTheStars.name: Chart the Stars
chartTheStars.note: One of these in an empire. Every ship of the realm sails a hex further, and so does anybody crossing the water on a raft.

theTurningHeavens.name: The Turning Heavens
theTurningHeavens.note: One of these in an empire, and only where there is a University to argue about it in.

theAlchemicalCodex.name: The Alchemical Codex
theAlchemicalCodex.note: One of these in an empire. Every soldier you have fights harder, and one that digs in mends faster.

theMagnumOpus.name: The Magnum Opus
theMagnumOpus.note: The great work of the age. Nobody may begin one until some empire in the world has reached Alchemy, and no empire may begin one until its own rod of beads is full. Gold and faith may be poured into it as well as production. The first one finished anywhere ends the game: the last measures of the age are taken for the record, and the empire that raised it wins.

chapel.name: Chapel
chapel.note: Every rite this city performs pays a little culture as well.

keep.name: Keep
keep.note: The town takes longer to empty, and your own units resting in it or beside it mend faster.

scriptorium.name: Scriptorium
scriptorium.note: Copies of everything, kept dry. It is worth more where a scholar's academy stands inside the town's borders.

assayHouse.name: Assay House
assayHouse.note: Coin weighed before it is spent. Anything this city buys with gold costs a little less.

cistern.name: Cistern
cistern.note: The city counts as standing on fresh water, and every desert hex it works feeds it a little better.
deferred: Farms out in the fields drawing their irrigation from this city as they would from a river. What waters a town and what waters a hex are two different questions today, and only the town's is answered.

assemblyHall.name: Assembly Hall
assemblyHall.note: Built in the seat of your government and nowhere else.

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.note: The hammers fall harder for every military Order standing in your government.

coinworks.name: Coinworks
coinworks.note: Coin struck where the town can watch it being struck. A share of everything this city earns is heard again as culture.

almshouse.name: Almshouse
almshouse.note: Settlers, workers and caravans may be bought with faith in the city that holds it, at the same rate gold buys them elsewhere.

orrery.name: Orrery
orrery.note: Brass rings turning at the speed of the heavens. It is worth more in a town raised within sight of a mountain.

assizeCourt.name: Assize Court
assizeCourt.note: A crowded town asks less of you while the justices sit.

relic.name: Relic
relic.note: An apostle may leave one of these in a town that has finished its cathedral. It is never built and never bought, and a town holds one at most.

heroicEpic.name: Heroic Epic
heroicEpic.note: The deeds of the realm set to verse, and sung where they were done.

imperialThrone.name: Imperial Throne
imperialThrone.note: The seat of the realm. The wider the realm, the further its writ carries. Soldiers raised in its shadow cost a little less to keep, for as long as they live.

highTemple.name: High Temple
highTemple.note: Your faith carries from here as far and as strongly as it does from a holy site.

tithes.name: Tithes
tithes.note: A way to turn spare production into gold when a city has little left worth building.

scholarship.name: Scholarship
scholarship.note: A way to turn spare production into science when a city has little left worth building.

pageants.name: Pageants
pageants.note: A way to turn spare production into culture when a city has little left worth building.
